baseline.guest_requirement: new exact artifact from the first Guest/ABI implementation commit

p2_overlap.baseline: unchanged source with two sequential Broker calls in a fresh Guest
p2_overlap.no_claim_if: correctness fails, overlap is absent, or treatment median is not lower
p2_overlap.primary_metric: complete Run wall time in nanoseconds
p2_overlap.retention_rule: retain Experimental/default-off only if both physical reads overlap, semantic gates pass, and treatment median complete-Run latency is lower than baseline after all overhead
p2_overlap.treatment: exact-Guest derived source with two submits before first materialization

p5_data_local.baseline: ordinary or existing prepared NumPy load plus dataset.sum in a fresh Guest
p5_data_local.retention_rule: result/error parity and strictly lower intended physical bytes; performance claim requires lower complete-Run median
p5_data_local.treatment: adapter-qualified Host data-local exact reduction materialized as a scalar

required: one qualified physical producer for matching requests
separate Run identities and terminal outcomes
p6_cross_run.retention_rule: no positive economic claim unless matched end-to-end cost improves over recompute/copy baselines

global_gates: focused go test -race for table/scheduler packages
new exact Guest artifact verification and exact-Guest E2E when Guest/ABI changes
independent post-fix review with no open Blocking/High/Medium finding
ledger_invariants: physical readiness does not create a logical call or receipt
Broker materialization owns each logical operation index and receipt
an unmaterialized later read is cancelled or discarded after an earlier failure
a targeted mismatch never falls back to a second live physical request
writes/approvals/captured playback never enter the split-phase table
no post-effect replay or mutable Python state reuse
